description: This Java class defines the LoanProduct entity within the Fineract project. It models various attributes of a loan product such as its name, description, related charges, interest details, repayment terms, and configuration settings. The class includes validation logic, relationships to other domain entities, and methods for updating and retrieving loan product properties, serving as a core component for loan product management in the system.

classes.name: LoanProduct
classes.description: Entity representing the configuration and properties of a loan product, including terms, charges, interest rates, repayment schedules, and validation logic.

methods.name: validateLoanProductPreSave
methods.description: Validates the loan product instance before saving, ensuring compliance with business rules and consistency of configurations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the charges associated with the loan product if there are changes.

methods.name: updateRates
methods.description: Updates the interest rates associated with the loan product if there are changes.

methods.name: loanProductFloatingRates
methods.description: Returns the floating rates configuration, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: loanProductVariableInstallmentConfig
methods.description: Returns or initializes the variable installment configuration.

methods.name: isAccountingDisabled
methods.description: Checks if accounting rule is set to NONE.

methods.name: isCashBasedAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if cash-based accounting rule is set.

methods.name: isUpfrontAccrualAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if upfront accrual accounting rule is set.

methods.name: isPeriodicAccrualAccountingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if periodic accrual accounting rule is set.

methods.name: getPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Returns the principal amount for the loan product.

methods.name: hasCurrencyCodeOf
methods.description: Checks if the loan product's currency matches the provided currency code.

methods.name: fetchBorrowerCycleVariationsForCycleNumber
methods.description: Returns a map of variation values for a specific borrower cycle number.

methods.name: fetchDaysInMonthType
methods.description: Returns the DaysInMonthType used in the loan product.

methods.name: fetchDaysInYearType
methods.description: Returns the DaysInYearType used in the loan product.

methods.name: isArrearsBasedOnOriginalSchedule
methods.description: Indicates whether arrears are calculated based on the original schedule.

methods.name: preCloseInterestCalculationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the strategy used to calculate pre-close interest.

methods.name: fetchInterestRates
methods.description: Retrieves the applicable interest rates for a given floating rate DTO.
